title: RC Strengthen, Weaken, and Resolution Question Strategy

notes.html:
Resolution Question Examples

  • Which one of the following, if true, would most help to explain the claim about the voices of opera singers?

  • Which one of the following, if true, would most help to make the suggestion in passage A that a harmless pathological liar's tall tales would not constitute sufficient reason to lie to him compatible with the Kantian argument laid out in the first paragraph of passage B?

Weaken Question Examples

  • Which one of the following most undermines the explanation provided in passage A for the effect that some medications have on patients?

  • Which one of the following, if true, would provide the strongest objection to the criticism in the passage of traditional education?

RC Strengthen Examples

  • Which one of the following, if true, would most help to strengthen the author's main claim in the last sentence of the passage?
